# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: email-worker.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: email-worker
  team: notifications
  tier: standard
spec:
  type: worker
  slos:
    success-rate:
      type: availability
      target: 99.0
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: email-templates-db
    type: database
    critical: false
  - name: email-queue
    type: queue
    critical: true
  ownership:
    team: notifications
